operator_config.name: conversionCheckMaxRestarts
operator_config.doc:
conversionCheckMaxRestarts caps how many times a single checkConversionHealth
call restarts pagination after an expired continue token (HTTP 410) before it
gives up and requeues, so a persistently churning cluster cannot spin the
reconcile worker in an unbounded in-process loop.

operator_config.name: conversionCheckPageLimit
operator_config.doc:
conversionCheckPageLimit bounds each page of the conversion-health LIST so
the check stays cheap even with many stored MCPServer objects.

operator_config.name: mcpServerGVR
operator_config.doc:
mcpServerGVR identifies the operand's MCPServer resource at the promoted
v1beta1 version. Listing at v1beta1 forces the API server to run the
conversion webhook against every stored (v1alpha1) object, so a failing
webhook surfaces as a LIST error.

operator_config.name: reasonConversionCheckFailed
operator_config.doc:
reasonConversionCheckFailed is set when listing MCPServers at v1beta1 fails
for any other reason, i.e. the conversion webhook is unhealthy.

operator_config.name: reasonConversionCheckPending
operator_config.doc:
reasonConversionCheckPending is set on MCPLifecycleOperatorAvailable when
the MCPServer CRD / its v1beta1 version is not served yet (transient).

operator_config.name: maxStorageMigrationRetries
operator_config.doc:
maxStorageMigrationRetries bounds the delete-and-recreate cycle. A
permanently broken conversion webhook would otherwise recreate the
migration - and poll discovery - every storageMigrationRequeueDelay
indefinitely. Once the budget is spent we stop and ask for intervention.

operator_config.name: storageMigrationAttemptAnnotation
operator_config.doc:
storageMigrationAttemptAnnotation records how many times this operator has
created the migration. It is carried on the object and threaded through
each delete-and-recreate so a persistent failure cannot churn forever.

operator_config.name: storageMigrationName
operator_config.doc:
storageMigrationName is the fixed name of the StorageVersionMigration this
operator drives. It matches the vendored reference manifest so an operator
applying it manually and the reconciler converge on the same object.

operator_config.name: storageMigrationPendingMessage
operator_config.value:
"The migration.k8s.io storage-version migrator API is not available yet; " +
	"install the storage-version migrator to migrate stored MCPServer objects to v1beta1"
operator_config.doc:
storageMigrationPendingMessage is surfaced while the migration.k8s.io API
is not served, so the condition is actionable rather than a hard failure.

operator_config.name: storageMigrationRequeueDelay
operator_config.doc:
storageMigrationRequeueDelay is how often to re-check a pending, running,
or failed migration. It is deliberately slower than defaultRequeueDelay:
the migration is a background signal excluded from operand readiness, and
re-running the whole reconcile every few seconds while it progresses (or
indefinitely on a cluster without the migrator) is wasteful.

operator_config.name: storageVersionMigrationGVR
operator_config.doc:
storageVersionMigrationGVR is the cluster-scoped StorageVersionMigration
resource. On OpenShift it is served by the openshift-kube-storage-version-
migrator operator; where absent, the migration reports Pending rather than
failing. The type is not in the manager scheme (nor vendored), so it is
handled via the dynamic client as unstructured.

operator_config.name: svmConditionSucceeded
operator_config.doc:
Condition types the storage-version migrator sets on the
StorageVersionMigration's status.conditions (migration.k8s.io/v1alpha1).
